name: Verify with ATOM
purpose: Face-ID verify, then POST /faceid so ATOM unlocks tier-3 tools for faceid_freshness_s seconds (default 300).

actions.notes: Stable human-readable device name; the bridge hashes it before storing.
Sent as ISO-8601; bridge parses with datetime.fromisoformat().
Pulls the bridge token you pasted into iCloud Keychain. Never hard-code the token here.
Optional -- sanity check {"ok": true, "accepted_at": ...}. Remove after first successful run.

troubleshooting.401 unauthorized: Re-paste config/bridge_token into the atom-bridge Keychain entry.
troubleshooting.409 device_conflict: Another iPhone claimed the slot. Run `rm data/trusted_iphone.json` on the Mac.
troubleshooting.Could not connect: Mac asleep, wrong IP/port, or bind_host is 127.0.0.1 instead of the LAN IP.
